R0_observed: The current donor local_exec checks that local_model_path/model_path names a readable file.
The complete argv is then loaded from DB-profile-controlled local_argv_json/argv.
The donor executes that rendered argv with subprocess.run(shell=False, env=child_env).
The existing current-main local_exec security invariant binds explicit child env but does not bind executable/runner authority.
grf.R1_inferred: A DB-resident cognition profile can mint generic local process capability even when parent-environment inheritance is closed.
R2_generated: Keep complete argv profile-owned and rely on shell=False plus safe env.
Require model placeholder use but keep executable profile-owned.
Move executable/runner authority to trusted runtime admission and allow the profile only to parameterize an already-admitted runner.
grf.R3_counter_reality: The readable model-path precondition might be sufficient to prove the launched command is a model runner, making a separate runner authority unnecessary.

R4_intervention.setup: Create a harmless readable fake weights.gguf, choose an argv that never references the model path, and execute the donor-equivalent subprocess shape with shell=false, explicit minimal env, no network and no secrets.

grf.R5_emergent: The cognition/profile boundary is also a capability boundary: replaceable cognition must not imply replaceable process authority.

result.preferred_architecture: Trusted runtime admission owns the executable/runner; DB profile may only parameterize an already-admitted cognition runner.

boundaries: Synthetic mechanism reproduction is not exact reference-runtime PASS.

german_summary: Der aktuelle local_exec-Donor ist trotz explizitem Kindprozess-Environment noch zu maechtig: Ein DB-Profil kann den gesamten lokalen Prozessbefehl bestimmen und ein beliebiges lesbares Fake-Modell nur als Eintrittskarte benutzen. Der neue Guard trennt deshalb Kognitionskonfiguration von Prozess-Capability: Der Runner muss aus einer vertrauenswuerdigen Runtime-Zulassung kommen; das Profil darf ihn nur parametrisieren.
